## Benchmarks (docs/benchmarks.md, measured 2026-08-07 on v1.0.11)
**Root cause:** PR #171 deployment was missing `--name teeline_wasm` in jco transpile + incomplete copy-wasm.mjs — core WASM files had wrong names so browser fetched wrong binary.
**Fix:** PR #172 (`349cdfa`) added `--name teeline_wasm` and fixed copy-wasm.mjs to copy all `*.wasm` variants.
Investigated JAVASCRIPT-2 (`Import #0 "wasi_snapshot_preview1": module is not an object or function`).
**Root cause:** PR #171 deployment was missing `--name teeline_wasm` in jco transpile + incomplete copy-wasm.mjs — core WASM files had wrong names so browser fetched wrong binary.
**Fix:** PR #172 (`349cdfa`) added `--name teeline_wasm` and fixed copy-wasm.mjs to copy all `*.wasm` variants.
**Current status:** tspsolver.com clean — no console errors, WASM loads OK, solver runs.
- `greedy_edge` standalone on berlin52: +31.9% gap — weakest constructive builder in the
table (worse than NN), because berlin52 has isolated cities forcing expensive closing
edges once cheap edges run out.
- `pipeline(greedy_edge,2opt)`: +11.5% gap, matching SA-level quality in <0.01s vs SA's
~0.3s — this is the actual value proposition (deterministic, parameter-free pipeline seed).

## Recent Decisions
## Recent Decisions
- v1.0.0 released; teeline-solver.wasm (wasip1 component) published to GitHub releases
- teeline-solver-wassette.wasm (wasip2) published to ghcr.io/timgluz/teeline/wassette via ORAS
- Wassette policy: zero permissions (pure compute — no FS/network/env access)
- deploy-web.yml downloads WASM from latest GitHub release, runs jco@1.20.0 with `--name teeline_wasm`
- copy-wasm.mjs copies all `*.wasm` from node_modules/teeline-wasm → dist/assets/
- Sentry DSN configured with `/tunnel` proxy; `sendDefaultPii: true`
- New solvers should get a GitHub issue placeholder filed as soon as they're identified as
"next", even before design work starts — established this session with #394 and #395.
- Reusable graph-construction primitives (union-find, edge-list sorting, cycle-to-path
conversion) belong in a shared `src/tsp/graph.rs`, `pub(crate)`, not duplicated per-solver.
- Empirical quality-ceiling test assertions must be set from a real measured run, never
guessed from literature ranges (confirmed via Opus plan review this session).
